The top-left cover features an orange alien creature; the top-right shows a superhero figure in blue and red; the bottom-left depicts a green dinosaur-like monster; and the bottom-center/bottom area shows a group of soldiers or characters in combat gear. The image captures the glossy texture of the paper and the vibrant, albeit aged, colors of the illustrations.
